summary: Iter-172 full backend + frontend regression of the new Container Shipments visualizer (2D/3D), per-item photo upload, AI URL estimate, and CSV bulk-import features. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. Frontend (Playwright on the live preview URL): admin /shipments → create shipment → manual-add item → CSV upload (2 rows previewed, items 1→3) → photo upload → AI-from-link triggered without crashing the page → 2D SVG (4 nodes) + 3D canvas (1 node) render with ZERO r3f x-line-number errors and no runtime-error overlay → public donor page renders shipment-donor-page with 3D canvas as default (defaultMode='3d' confirmed) → donation dialog opens and accepts qty/name. One real FE bug found: duplicate data-testid='ship-donor-name' (page <h1> AND the donor form <Input>). Everything else green.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid='ship-donor-name' on TWO different elements: (1) the page hero <h1> on line 101 (`{data.name}`) and (2) the donor name <Input> inside the confirm-donation dialog on line 242. This is a testability bug — any selector targeting ship-donor-name resolves to 2 elements and may bind to the wrong one. Functionally the form still works for end users (the input is the only editable one), but breaks data-testid contract and Playwright tests.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Rename the donor form input to data-testid="ship-donor-donor-name" (or ship-donor-name-input) and keep ship-donor-name on the hero h1, OR vice-versa. Each data-testid must be unique on the page.

action_items: Fix duplicate data-testid='ship-donor-name' in /app/frontend/src/pages/ShipmentDonorPage.jsx — same id is used on both the hero <h1> and the donor name <Input> (lines 101 + 242). Rename one of them.
(Optional) The 2D viz currently renders 4 SVG nodes — verify intentionally (e.g. nested decorative svgs for icons inside the card) so future tests can assert a tighter count.
critical_code_review_comments: ContainerVisualizer.jsx: the ThreeCanvas component correctly uses React.createElement(Canvas/primitive/OrbitControls,...) instead of JSX so the visual-edits Babel plugin can't inject x-line-number/x-component props onto R3F primitives. Verified live: 3D mode loads a <canvas> on both admin and public donor pages with ZERO 'Cannot set x-line-number' or related r3f applyProps errors. Solid fix.

shipments.py POST /items/bulk-import (line 377) silently skips rows with empty name and clamp-failures via try/except. Good for resilience but the API only returns {imported:N} — consider also returning skipped_count so the FE can show 'Imported 2 of 3 rows (1 skipped: missing name)'.
shipments.py public_shipment (line 542) now correctly includes `pallets` (lite roster) + `container_dims_cm` — verified via test_public_payload_includes_pallets.
ShipmentDonorPage.jsx defaultMode='3d' is wired through to ContainerVisualizer — confirmed by the public donor screenshot showing a <canvas> immediately on load, even without user interaction.

estimate-from-link endpoint returned 200 with a real estimate even on example.com/dp/B000FAKE (LLM happily hallucinates dims) — consider validating that the AI's confidence is above a threshold before silently overwriting weight_kg/dims_cm on the item, otherwise an operator may not notice the values are made up. Currently it does write — see line 264 onwards.

rca of the issue: Bug: data-testid collision on 'ship-donor-name'. RCA: same identifier is reused for two semantically different elements in /app/frontend/src/pages/ShipmentDonorPage.jsx — the hero shipment-title <h1> on line 101 displays {data.name} (the shipment name), and the donor's name <Input> on line 242 captures the donor's name. Both got the same handle 'ship-donor-name' because both relate conceptually to a 'name' on the donor page. Repro: in Playwright run `page.fill('[data-testid="ship-donor-name"]', 'X')` — locator resolves to 2 elements, fills the h1 first, throws because h1 isn't fillable. Mitigation: change one of the testids. Suggested rename: hero h1 stays 'ship-donor-name' (it identifies the shipment), and the form input becomes 'ship-donor-donor-name-input' or 'ship-donor-name-field'. Either way each testid must be globally unique on a rendered page.
